name: Wuxi Rich Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd.
summary: Wuxi Rich Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd. engages in designing, manufacturing, installation, commissioning, consulting, training, and after-sales support services worldwide. It offers unpacking and feeding, metering and conveying, mixing and blending, dispersing and emulsifying, calendaring and casting, grinding and homogenizing, degassing and impurity removal, cleaning and washing, and discharging and filling products. Its products are used in lithium battery manufacturing, fine chemicals, new energy, adhesives and sealants, electronic materials, composite materials, food, pharmaceutical and daily chemicals, and composite material industries.
